notes.title: [v1.3.14] 1/20 (Sat) update
notes.content:
Hello, this is Studio 215.
Thank you for playing Darkmatter: The Strange Messenger.

- Newly renewed animations for player characters. Animations are now smoother and judgments are more accurate overall.
- Added some background graphics.
- Fixed an issue where the buff could not be acquired again after checking the movement buff tooltip.
- Data load structure has been changed. The loading time for title entry has been reduced and the loading time for game entry has been increased.
- Boss monster attack detection has been improved.

We will continue to update as soon as new items are added or issues are discovered.
Thank you for your interest.

notes.title: [v1.3.8] 12/15 (Fri) update
notes.content:
Hello, this is Studio 215.
Thank you for playing Darkmatter: The Strange Messenger.

After release, several issues were discovered and additional updates were made.

bug fix
- Fixed UI panel malfunction when switching controllers with keyboard
-Corrected some skill UI descriptions
- Edit playback order of some particles

Improved convenience
- Blank click limit in inventory UI
- Improved inventory knowledge decision socket UI
- Improved waterfall environmental sounds
- Quantity UI removed when holding 1 inventory item

Improved balance
- "Format" item price downwards

We will continue to issue additional updates as soon as we find any issues.
Thank you for your interest.

notes.title: Dark Matter: The Strange Messenger, Update demo version
notes.content:
Hello, this is Studio 215.

Thank you for playing the demo.
We updated the demo version to reflect the valuable feedback you provided in the last demo.

Update demo version
- Change the title screen image
- Npc Image Update: Each merchant dressed up.
- Less inside holes: Your stress is reduced now.
- Add Buff Storage (Attack Speed, Move Speed): For a short time, you can experience the highest speed.
- Improve directional operation when moving: You can now move more smoothly.
- Some UI/UX improvements

Users who installed the demo before September 25th should delete the demo and install the new demo and play it if the version at the bottom right of the title screen is not v1.1.6.


If you give an honest and free opinion through the demo questionnaire, it will be a great help to improve it to be a better game.
Questionnaire link: https://forms.gle/iR6oPmPXQctjre4z7

You can also play it on STEAM NEXT FAST from October 9 to October 16, 2023.

Discord: https://discord.gg/hDyZNJJ36t
